records.name: Portna Canal
records.postcode_notes: No BT postcode-coordinate enrichment included; commercial reuse of Northern Ireland postcode data requires a separate licence.
records.access_notes: From age 12, a DAERA coarse or game rod licence and fishing permit are required. Open all year. Public coarse canal venue. Fishing is restricted to the stretch below the locks; the rocky upstream banks are inaccessible and dangerous. Take care near the River Bann confluence because of deep water and strong current. Parking is available. Static boat fishing is allowed, but trolling is prohibited. Coordinate is the DAERA-published map-view centre.
